report.explanation: All checkout observations returned 200; the alert shows one 344ms outlier against 62-78ms peers, and gateway metrics show 0 502s with p95 425ms. Traces show healthy downstream spans (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) with no errors. No evidence establishes a bounded root cause; the single slow request is insufficient to attribute a fault.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency breakdown for the 344ms checkout request to localize the slow span
Baseline p95/p99 latency for /v1/checkout over a longer window to confirm whether 344ms is anomalous
Downstream service (order/inventory/payment) latency metrics to rule out downstream-latency
DB connection pool saturation metrics to rule out db-pool-exhaustion
Redis operation latency/error metrics to rule out redis-timeout
